problems.title: Sphere circumscribing a right-section cone
problems.question: A cone is inscribed in a sphere and has right-triangle axial section of are a 9. Find sphere volume.
problems.idea: Respect the domain and use the relevant algebra, calculus, or geometry formula.
formulas: The axial triangle is isosceles right, with base diameter2r and height r. Its are a r²=9 gives r=3.
steps: The triangle’s circumradius is half its hypotenuse, so sphere radius 3. Volume=(4/3)π·27=36π.

problems.title: Intersections of even logarithmic and exponential graphs
problems.question: How many intersections have y=|log₃|x|| and y=3^|x|?
problems.idea: Respect the domain and use the relevant algebra, calculus, or geometry formula.
formulas: Put t=|x|>0. For0<t<1,−log₃t decreases from∞ to 0 while3ᵗ increases, so exactly one crossing occurs.
steps: For t≥1, log₃t<t<3ᵗ, so there are no crossings. The single positive t gives two abscissas x=±t.

problems.question: An elliptical section of a cylinder has minor semiaxis1, and the axial section is square. Find cylinder volume.
problems.idea: Respect the domain and use the relevant algebra, calculus, or geometry formula.
formulas: For a complete oblique section of a right circular cylinder, the minor semiaxis is its radius r=1.
steps: Square axial section gives h=2r=2. Volume=πr²h=2π.

problems.question: Find the distance between foci of x²−y²=2.
problems.idea: Respect the domain and use the relevant algebra, calculus, or geometry formula.
formulas: The standard equation has a²=b²=2, c²=a²+b²=4.
steps: Thus c=2, and focus separation2c=4.

problems.question: Find the distance between the directrices of y²=−4x and y²=8x.

steps: Here p=−1 and 2, so the lines are x=1 and x=−2. Their distance is 3.

problems.title: Reflect a tangent to an even function
problems.question: A tangent to an even function at x₀ is y=−3x+5. Find the tangent at −x₀.
problems.idea: Respect the domain and use the relevant algebra, calculus, or geometry formula.
formulas: An even graph is symmetric about the y-axis. Reflecting a tangent replaces x by −x.
steps: The reflected line is y=3x+5.

problems.title: Foci of an ellipse inscribed in a rectangle
problems.question: An ellipse touches all sides of the rectangle x=−5,15 and y=−6,10. Find its focal separation.
problems.idea: Respect the domain and use the relevant algebra, calculus, or geometry formula.
formulas: For the usual axis-aligned ellipse, centre=(5,2), semiaxes a=10, b=8, c=√(a²−b²)=6.
steps: Thus its foci are 12 apart.
problems.note: Tangency to all four sides alone also permits rotated ellipses, so the wording does not uniquely determine the focal distance without the usual parallel-axis assumption.

problems.title: A limit through an unspecified differentiable function
problems.question: Given f(0)=3, f′(0)≠0, find lim[3log₃f(x)−3]/[f(x)²−9] as x→0.
problems.idea: Respect the domain and use the relevant algebra, calculus, or geometry formula.
formulas: Let t=f(x)→3. The derivative ratio of numerator and denominator at t=3 is[3/(3ln3)]/6.
steps: The nonzero derivative condition allows cancellation of the first-order change of f. The limit is 1/(6ln3).

problems.title: Differentiate a logarithm with variable base
problems.question: Find the derivative of y=log_(x²+1)(x²) at x=1.
problems.idea: Respect the domain and use the relevant algebra, calculus, or geometry formula.
formulas: y=ln(x²)/ln(x²+1). At x=1, the numerator is 0.
steps: The quotient derivative therefore reduces to[2/x]/ln(x²+1) at 1, which is 2/ln2.

problems.title: Pyramid above a base vertex
problems.question: A square-base pyramid has its height through a base vertex. Its two distinct lateral-face areas are 2 and 2.5. Find total are a.
problems.idea: Respect the domain and use the relevant algebra, calculus, or geometry formula.
formulas: With base side s, height h, the two face-are a types are sh/2 and s√(s²+h²)/2. The latter is larger.
steps: Their squared difference is s⁴/4=2.5²−2²=9/4, so s²=3. Lateral are a=2·2+2·2.5=9.
Total are a=3+9=12.
